text:
[LFAC.1.7.4] **Require-all.** Every slot of a `logical`
schema must be marked `key` or `mutable`. The compiler rejects
an unmarked slot on a `logical` schema. Require-all is the
forcing function: no slot is unmarked, so there is no
default-direction question and no silent guess. The one slot it
does not reach is `ts`, which is the engine's and carries no marker
([LFAC.9.1]).

alloy.name: lfac_1_7_4__logical_slots_all_marked
alloy.note: Require-all over the author slots: every slot of a logical schema but ts is KEY or MUTABLE, and ts is the one slot it does not reach (LFAC.9.1). Bounded: six slots, six schemas.

alloy.name: lfac_9_1__ts_unmarked
alloy.note: A ts slot carries no KEY or MUTABLE marker on any schema: ENGINE on a logical schema, UNSPECIFIED elsewhere. Bounded: six slots, six schemas; fails if the partition's ENGINE line is dropped.
